description: Full public details of one AI tool by slug: description, pricing types and price, categories, tags, listing types, website link, FAQs, pros and cons, similar tools, rating, verified flag, status and canonical URL. For offline or merged tools it says so and returns the replacement or alternatives.

locale.description: Language of names, descriptions and URLs (site locale code). Default: en.

slug.description: Tool slug as in the tool URL, e.g. "chatgpt".

name: get_tool
title: Get AI tool details
